title: Simple Rose Golden+
description: This project adds Rose Gold to Minecraft ~!
body:
# Simple Rose Golden+
![Simple Rose Gold+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa38bf29e39048f8b080a0f884fdb7cd70abdff5.png)

## Dependencies
You need to install the **[Simple Rose Golden+ Resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/simple-rose-gold+-resourcepack)** for this Datapack to work.

## About:
Simple Rose Golden + is another passion project I made because I tried to find a Rose Gold plugin with no extra twist for free, but didn't find anything. In the future I will definetely add Rose Gold Foods for Simple Golden+ .
